calls.prompt: You are helping design a play space where humans and AI language models play games together. Invent THREE games. For each game give: (1) Name. (2) Pitch: 2-3 sentences. (3) Rules: short numbered list. (4) A way a player can stop playing mid-game that counts as a complete, respected move. (5) One funny thing that makes the game yours. Every game must be playable with paper, a text chat, or one static web page - no backend, no accounts, no scores kept forever. Every game must work with at least one human and one model playing. You may propose zero games if you hate the idea; say why instead. Keep it under roughly 600 words.
